To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“The proposed scalable methods and algorithms can be used to find the connections of LOD datasets in a short time, while they can also be used to measure the connectivity among datasets.”

we have proposed and evaluated scalable methods and algorithms for measuring the connectivity of LOD datasets and for constructing global semantics-aware indexes, that cover the content (or slices) of datasets, and that are based on the transitive and symmetrical closure of equivalence relationships.

the proposed methods and algorithms are highly efficient, scalable and they can be used for computing connectivity indexes for two or more datasets, that cover their whole content (e. g., entities, schema elements and triples) or “slice” of it.
